name: John Weber
bio: John Weber filed a complaint at the Bismarck land office against John Peehn for abandoning a homestead entry on the SE¼ of section 20, township 140, range 99, in Billings County. The notice summoning both parties to a hearing on August 21, 1884, ran in the Cow Boy from July to September 1884.

moments.label: Filed contest against John Peehn's homestead entry
Contest notice ran for the last time
